purpose: Select a defensible implemented C9 multiuser behavior decision; not an automated grade or human preference study.

anchors: 3: directly answers C9 with observable alternatives
3: precise normative choice with strong counter-case and contextual limits
3: README-rule-check-artifact chain, exact scope and falsifier
3: strongest counter-case and when preferred alternative changes
3: short observable task plus meaningful failure/denial/recovery case

eligibility: A main candidate must be implemented, govern actual multiuser behavior, have code/commit evidence and admit a credible alternative. No human value or HD inference from passing checks.
candidates: B: explicit willingness separate from presence
C: shared canvas versus author-controlled study commitments
D: persistent membership versus browser connections
E: bedroom access/retained history versus decoration authority
F: pending versus acknowledged saved actions
methods: Controlled technical policy comparison with actual isolated stores and explicit prototype baselines, if it discriminates behavior
Fresh-context independent candidate review; reversed presentation order
Parent reconciliation/refinement followed by skeptical final review
disqualifiers: CRDT/OT or universal peer-safe undo falsely attributed
Quiet falsely described as enforced consent/DND
Tests/model preference presented as human validation
noProductionChange: Research/report work; all prototypes isolated, no live-user mutations or runtime/CI changes.
stopConditions: One primary decision and at most one supporting decision chosen with traceable reasons
Two bounded review/refinement cycles complete and evidence defects resolved
Technical comparison records legitimate advantages of alternatives, not only chosen-policy wins
English recommendation/source/evidence files validated; student personal reflection not fabricated
